payload.prompt:
Review the new lesson_phases feature. Plan is in PLAN_lesson_phases.md at repo root. Files to review:

1. supabase/migrations/005_lesson_phases.sql (51 lines) — new table + RLS
2. supabase/seed_lesson_phases.py (429 lines) — teacher-tex parser + upsert seed
3. web/js/api.js lines 116-128 — new listPhasesForLesson method
4. web/js/item-detail.js (183 lines) — phase-grouped renderItemList

Dry-run output: 152 rows across 19 lessons, 21 unmatched labels (mostly prose-only Do Nows and Optional Practice without numeric ID — acceptable per plan).

Review focus:
- Parser correctness: brace-balanced extraction, phase detection (\sectionbanner / \frameworkphaseheader / \phasetag), label→id resolution (parens / Try It N / Practice #N). Any edge cases missed?
- SQL safety: migration 005 is idempotent re-run-safe? FK ON DELETE behavior correct? RLS + grants match 004 pattern?
- Seed idempotency: per-lesson DELETE-then-INSERT avoids position collisions on re-run?
- Web UI: does renderItemList correctly handle (a) empty phases → flat fallback, (b) phase with item_id=NULL → non-clickable label row, (c) 'Other items' collapsible showing items NOT in any phase?
- Anything that would silently break if the data is slightly unexpected (empty file, missing sectionbanner, item_id that references deleted item)?

Do NOT run the seed with --apply (no SUPABASE env). Do NOT modify code unless you find a real bug — if you do, make the minimal fix. Report findings + any edits under 400 words.
